name: MOVE between types: a REAL and a DINT into INTs

tags.name: Reading
tags.comment: a REAL, with a decimal point: − and + step by 0.5

tags.name: Big
tags.comment: a DINT: whole numbers up to about 2.1 billion

tags.name: Small
tags.comment: an INT: Big, if it fits; past 32,767 it wraps round

rungs.comment: A REAL into an INT is rounded: 2.7 gives 3, and exactly .5 goes to the even number, so 2.5 gives 2 and 3.5 gives 4.
A DINT into an INT: up to 32,767 it fits. One more and it wraps round to -32,768, with no warning.
